newsitem.title: DENMARK: Copenhagen Airports see 97 growth as 96.
newsitem.headline: Copenhagen Airports see 97 growth as 96.

text.p: Copenhagen Airports said on Thursday it expected its 1997 results to show the same rise as in 1996.

"We expect a positive trend again in 1997, when we foresee passenger traffic rising to around 17 million. By the year 2000 it should have reached some 20 million," Copenhagen Airports said in a statement accompanying its 1996 result.
"On the basis of last year the company foresees a stable improvement in its result for 1997 at the same level as from 1995 until 1996," it said.
Copenhagen Airports reported a rise in 1996 pre-tax profits to 422 million crowns from 1995's 376 million crowns.
The company operates Copenhagen International Airport and a small airfield west of the capital. Total passenger traffic in 1996 was 16.1 million. --Per Bech Thomsen +45-33969656
